title: GraphQLRequest
description: A GraphQL request containing the query and optional parameters

query.description: The GraphQL query or mutation string. Queries operate within the UIAPI namespace, accessing records via uiapi.query.{ObjectName}.

variables.description: Variables for parameterized queries. Keys correspond to variable names defined in the query.

operationName.description: Name of the operation to execute when the query document contains multiple operations.
